messages:
sanjay: Heads up — after last night's kernel-selection + attn-fusion roll I see a noticeable p99 regression on small-ctx (512) workloads in us-west-2 prod. p50 looks unchanged, p95 + ~5%, p99 up ~100ms (was ~500ms, now ~600ms). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/xyz :eyes:

olivia: Which commit rolled? model/route? hosted or dedicated? any canary results before full rollout?

sanjay: rolled `def456` (kernel-selection heuristic + fused-attn-v2). Affected model: redwood-vicuna-7b (quantized int8). Hosted public API, region us-west-2. Canary was 10% last night, then 100% at 03:12 UTC.

maria: I saw a similar bump in staging for 1024 ctx tests earlier — throughput unchanged but tails spiked. My suspicion: kernel selector prefers fused_attn_v2 for sequences under 768 now, but that path has an unexpected serialization point w/ our batching scheduler.

devon: Can you paste the small reproducer? also include run config (batch sizes, max_tokens, arrival pattern). we should rule out input-distribution change.

sanjay: quick repro command I used locally:
```
./scripts/smokebench.sh --model redwood-vicuna-7b --ctx 512 --concurrency 16 --rate 200 --commit def456 --runs 30
```
Local quick summary (last run):
```
bench summary
model: redwood-vicuna-7b
p50: 120ms
p95: 320ms
p99: 610ms
throughput: 180 tps
```

bench-bot: Automated bench from canary cluster (10% traffic) 1789502520:
- p50: 118ms
- p95: 330ms
- p99: 605ms
- 99.9p: 820ms
- note: throughput within SLA

olivia: Good that throughput is fine. That 99.9 spike +820ms points to scheduling/backpressure or mis-estimated kernel cost in selector. Two quick checks:
1) re-run with env `RW_KERNEL_SELECTION=legacy` (force old selector) to confirm revert effect
2) run microbench of fused_attn_v2 singularly across seq lengths to check where perf cliff occurs

maria: I'll run microbench on dedicated infra and collect GPU timelines + nvprof counters. Also check if quantization path differs for fused_attn_v2 (we had a flagged codepath for int8 remat).

devon: If `RW_KERNEL_SELECTION=legacy` fixes it, we should hotfix by pinning the selector and open an RFC follow-up for selection cost-model calibration. We need better per-model profiles instead of single heuristic.

sanjay: Quick toggle result: forcing legacy selector restored p99 back to ~505ms on canary run (same inputs). So selector looks causally related.

olivia: OK — immediate mitigation: canary rollback + pin selector for redwood-vicuna-7b. For long-term: add a calibration job that computes empirical kernel costs per model/ctx and stores a profile used by selector. Also add an alert if p99 delta > 20% after selector change.

maria: Filing ticket for calibration job + test harness. Also adding a correctness check: run KV-cache smoke tests for quantized fused_attn_v2 since we've seen mismatch risks.

devon: Agree. I'll draft a short RFC follow-up with these tradeoffs: maintain simple heuristic vs. cost-profile per model (storage/ops complexity). Suggest interface: `KernelProfile { model, ctx_ranges, measured_costs_ms, stable_until }` and selector checks profile age.

sanjay: I'll open the canary rollback PR and patch to pin selector by model until we ship the calibration. Plan: 10% canary -> 0% (rollback) within 30m if p99 > 550ms.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback started (PR #789) — rolling service updates to revert kernel-selection changes for redwood-vicuna-7b in us-west-2.

bench-bot: Post-rollback canary snapshot (1789502590): p99: 508ms, p95: 312ms, throughput: 179 tps. Looks back to baseline.

olivia: Nice. Follow-ups: (1) devon to own RFC, (2) maria to run microbench+nvprof artifacts and attach to ticket, (3) bench-team to add automated calibration job in CI that runs weekly for heavy models.

sanjay: Thanks all — I'll monitor dashboards and post updates in this thread once RFC/PRs land. :thumbsup:
